description: Source code for executing system commands with output capture and logging, including functions os_cmd_exec_xv, os_cmd_exec_x, and os_cmd_exec.

methods.name: os_cmd_exec_xv
methods.description: Executes a command with formatted input, captures output, logs output lines, and returns success status.

methods.name: os_cmd_exec_x
methods.description: Wrapper around os_cmd_exec_xv with variadic arguments for command formatting.

methods.name: os_cmd_exec
methods.description: Simplified function to execute a command and capture output with default flags.
